content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"The great stone heads of Sacsayhuamán still guard the hill, and the views over Cusco are pure Inti (the sun) gold."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"San Pedro Market is a swirl of colours, smells and market chatter; the fruit stalls are a feast for the eyes."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Inside the cathedral the silver altar glows, and the colonial paintings hide a few cheeky Andean touches."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Museo Inka walks you through the empire's craft and gold, with textiles so fine they look woven from light."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Inca stonework meets colonial arches here, and the old sun temple still holds its quiet power."},{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The big square is the city's living room: cathedral on one side, mountain light on the other."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the steep lanes of San Blas for little workshops, painted balconies and a slower Cusco."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A warm, wood-toned spot with proper vegetarian choices and a menu that treats vegetables like the main event."}]}
